mapper.select: select (select coalesce(sum(pay_amount), 0) from mall_order where pay_status = 'PAID') as total_sales, (select count(*) from mall_order where pay_status = 'PAID') as paid_orders, (select count(*) from mall_order) as total_orders, (select coalesce(sum(pay_amount), 0) from mall_order where pay_status = 'PAID' and date(pay_time) = curdate()) as today_sales, (select count(*) from mall_order where pay_status = 'PAID' and date(pay_time) = curdate()) as today_orders, (select count(*) from sys_user) as member_count, (select count(*) from mall_product where status = 1) as on_sale_products, (select count(*) from mall_order where status = 'PENDING_DELIVERY') as pending_delivery, (select count(*) from mall_refund where status = 'PENDING') as refunding, (select count(*) from mall_review) as review_count

select date_format(pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, coalesce(sum(pay_amount), 0) as sales, count(*) as orders from mall_order where pay_status = 'PAID' and pay_time >= #{begin} group by date_format(pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by date asc

select date_format(pay_time, '%Y-%m') as date, coalesce(sum(pay_amount), 0) as sales, count(*) as orders from mall_order where pay_status = 'PAID' and pay_time >= #{begin} group by date_format(pay_time, '%Y-%m') order by date asc

select coalesce(c3.id, c2.id, c1.id) as category_id, coalesce(c3.name, c2.name, c1.name) as category_name, coalesce(sum(oi.total_amount), 0) as amount, coalesce(sum(oi.number), 0) as quantity from mall_order_item oi join mall_order o on o.id = oi.order_id and o.pay_status = 'PAID' join mall_product p on p.id = oi.product_id join mall_category c1 on c1.id = p.category_id left join mall_category c2 on c2.id = c1.parent_id left join mall_category c3 on c3.id = c2.parent_id group by category_id, category_name order by amount desc

select oi.product_id as product_id, oi.product_name as product_name, coalesce(sum(oi.number), 0) as quantity, coalesce(sum(oi.total_amount), 0) as amount from mall_order_item oi join mall_order o on o.id = oi.order_id and o.pay_status = 'PAID' group by oi.product_id, oi.product_name order by quantity desc, amount desc limit #{limit}
